timing_rules: inv is computed combinational as BITVAL ^ CRC[15] (the MSB of the current CRC)
If Enable is high, on rising CLK edge, CRC is shifted left and updated: CRC[12] <= CRC[11] ^ inv; CRC[5] <= CRC[4] ^ inv; CRC[0] <= inv; other bits shift from previous CRC[i-1]
If Enable is low, CRC holds its value
RST assertion overrides Enable, forcing CRC to 0

If both RST and Enable high, RST takes precedence (CRC set to 0)
When Enable is low, CRC holds its value
